firm_note.text: Scottsdale Wealth Planning was founded and is led by Paul Ohanian, who has served as Founder, CEO, and Chief Compliance Officer since establishing the firm; he personally directs the firm's investment strategies as chair of the SWP Investment Committee.

Paul Christopher Ohanian.bio_note: Paul Ohanian has led financial strategies for over 30 years, beginning his career as a CPA before founding Scottsdale Wealth Planning; holds a B.S. in Accounting from Southern Illinois University, Carbondale; is a CFP, CPA (inactive), and holds Series 3, 4, 63, 65, and 66 licenses plus an insurance license; his commentary has appeared in the Arizona Republic, Smart Money, and CNBC, and he contributes to the Arizona Journal of Business and Real Estate on REITs and global markets.
Paul Christopher Ohanian.bio_source: Firm website (scottsdalewealthplanning.com/our-team/); web search corroborated the same career facts and credentials via LinkedIn and firm press coverage.

firm_note.text: Prosper Private Wealth is a small, Mesa, AZ-based RIA providing discretionary investment management, financial planning, and retirement-plan consulting; led by CEO Joshua Gardner.
firm_note.source: Web search (U.S. News Financial Advisors firm profile)

Joshua Adam Gardner.bio_note: Website lists Gardner's CFP credential and role with no narrative. Web search found he has 24 years of experience in financial services, with prior roles at Summit Global Investments and Fidelity in both advisory and brokerage capacities.
Joshua Adam Gardner.bio_source: Firm website (prosperpw.com); web search (advisor profile aggregator); ZoomInfo: no contact record found for Joshua Gardner at Prosper Private Wealth.

firm_note.text: Stableford Capital, formed in 2014 and based in Scottsdale, AZ, was founded by Andrew Brinkman and is led by a leadership team with deep institutional investing and tax/finance backgrounds, including Managing Partner Justin Thomas and CFO/CCO Mark Rehn.
firm_note.source: Firm website (stablefordcapital.com/leadership/) and web search corroboration

Andrew Joseph Brinkman.bio_note: Founder & CEO of Stableford Capital. Career history: Financial Advisor at Baird (2006-2014) and Merrill (2005-2006), COO/CFO of Petros Capital, a long/short institutional hedge fund (1999-2004), CFO of Sequel Systems (1998-1999), and Foreign Exchange Trader at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (1981-1997). Over a 45+ year career he built A.J. Brinkman & Co. (foreign exchange arbitrageur/institutional floor broker), was a member of the Chicago Mercantile Exchange, New York Futures Exchange, and Chicago Board of Trade, and holds a B.A. from Cornell College.
Andrew Joseph Brinkman.bio_source: ZoomInfo contact enrichment; web search via stablefordcapital.com/leadership/andrew-brinkman

Justin C Thomas.bio_note: Partner and Managing Partner at Stableford Capital per the firm website. A CPA with over 15 years of experience as a portfolio manager and analyst managing institutional assets for hedge funds and large financial institutions, including 8 years as an equity analyst and portfolio manager at PartnerRe Asset Management, a global reinsurance company.
Justin C Thomas.bio_source: ZoomInfo search_contacts; web search via stablefordcapital.com/leadership/justin-thomas and LinkedIn

Mark Rehn.bio_note: Chief Financial Officer & Chief Compliance Officer at Stableford Capital. Over 35 years of leadership experience in corporate finance and taxation, including Tax Director for a global styrene manufacturer overseeing Americas tax matters, and Assistant General Counsel and Senior Tax Manager for a global telecommunications/IT company managing its corporate tax department. Holds an LL.M. in Taxation and J.D. from DePaul University College of Law, passed the Illinois Bar Exam and Michigan CPA exam.
Mark Rehn.bio_source: ZoomInfo search_contacts; web search via stablefordcapital.com/leadership/mark-rehn and Chicago Business

firm_note.text: Luminescent Wealth Management, Inc. is a boutique, independently-owned, fee-only RIA in Scottsdale, AZ, co-founded in 2025 by Erin Itkoe and Trevor Scheid, both of whom previously worked together at Tarbox Family Office and Versant Capital Management before starting the firm.

Erin Beth Itkoe.bio_note: Resolves a prior data-quality flag: confirmed as the same person previously at Tarbox Family Office (Director, Financial Planning) who left to co-found Luminescent Wealth Management with Trevor Scheid in 2025. Career began in 2003; prior roles include Director of Financial Planning at Tarbox Family Office, Senior Wealth Counselor and Director of Client Experience at Versant Capital Management, and Manager of Investment Operations/Relationship Manager at GenSpring Family Offices. CPA/PFS and CFP, also an Accredited Estate Planner and Chartered Advisor in Philanthropy. Recognition: named one of Az Business Magazine's '12 Millennials to Watch' (2019) and received the AICPA Personal Financial Planning Standing Ovation award (2017).

firm_note.text: Website (vigilarewealth.com) confirms Jason Polit and Jag Zdrale co-founded the firm; both previously worked together at Charles Schwab as Portfolio Consultants before launching Vigilare with the stated goal of protecting and growing client wealth.

Jason Scott Polit.bio_note: Co-founder and CIO of Vigilare. Graduated Cum Laude in Finance from the University of Arizona while working full-time; earned his CFA charter in 2004. Spent over a decade at Charles Schwab (late-1990s stock/options trading desks, IPO operations, helped build Schwab's early advice offerings as it shifted from transaction-based to service-based, was a media liaison quoted in CNBC/Reuters coverage, and led Schwab's flagship Private Client program training other consultants). Volunteers as a life coach mentoring young people on financial fitness.

Zeljko Jag Zdrale.bio_note: Co-founder, Managing Member, and Global Market Strategist; heads Vigilare's Investment Committee, which sets the firm's global markets and investment outlook. Like Polit, spent his prior career at Charles Schwab as a Portfolio Consultant (~12 years finance industry experience per public advisor records) before co-founding Vigilare.

firm_note.text: No firm website was on file; web search identified the firm's actual site as onewealthmgmt.com. Firm has offices in Scottsdale, Los Angeles, Paso Robles, and Chicago, serving clients nationally.

Jeremy Paul Dicker.bio_note: Founder, CEO, and CCO of One Wealth. Began his financial services and insurance career at age 17 (the day before turning 18); has said early hardships shaped his drive to help others build financial security. Built One Wealth around a client-first, 'ultra-high-touch' personalized planning philosophy. Holds Arizona and California insurance licenses and is a Finseca member since 2021. Lives in Phoenix with his wife Brandi and their two children; active in financial literacy and community development causes.

firm_note.text: Website (intrinsicwealthcounsel.com/about-us) confirms an independent, fee-only financial planning and wealth management firm emphasizing integration of clients' financial lives with personal goals and 'compassionate fiduciary care.'

Cornelius Henry Van zutphen.bio_note: Known publicly as 'Neal.' Founder and President; holds M.S., CFP, FBS (Certified Financial Behavior Specialist), and CRPC designations. Began his financial services career in 1983 (35+ years in the industry, 34+ in personal financial planning). Co-authored a research article, 'Financial Planner as Healer: Maximizing the Role of Financial Health Physician,' published in the Journal of Financial Planning (Dec. 2016), and has served as a CFP Board Ambassador. No source explicitly confirmed a family relationship to Casey Van Zutphen despite the shared surname — not assumed.

Cornelius H. Van zutphen.bio_note: Known publicly as 'Casey.' Partner, Chief Investment Officer, and Portfolio Manager; holds CFA and CFP designations. One outside source described him as Neal's 'partner and portfolio manager based in California,' but no source explicitly confirmed a familial relationship to Neal Van Zutphen despite the shared surname — not assumed or stated as fact.

Daniela Urs Jones.bio_note: CFP and CFA charterholder; Partner at Intrinsic Wealth Counsel since 2018, focused on client life planning. Graduated Magna Cum Laude from Saint Mary's College (Notre Dame, IN) with a BBA in Finance, Marketing, and International Business. Prior to IWC, spent ~12 years (2005-2017) as a wealth manager at Barnes Investment Advisory, a Phoenix-based RIA. Member of CFA Society Phoenix and the Financial Planning Association of Greater Phoenix.
Daniela Urs Jones.bio_source: Firm website (intrinsicwealthcounsel.com/about-us/daniela-jones/); LinkedIn; one targeted web search

Originally from Cameroon; has lived in Arizona for 20+ years. Graduated Summa Cum Laude from the University of Arizona (B.S., Business Administration) and holds a master's in Finance from the University of Scranton, matching the M.S.F. noted on the firm site; also pursuing the IACCP designation and holds a registered paraplanner certification.
